title: LIQUIDITY_POOL_WITHDRAW fails with LIQUIDITY_POOL_WITHDRAW_LINE_FULL
pattern: A transaction whose LIQUIDITY_POOL_WITHDRAW operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (line_full). The account's NRV sits in the pool and its NRV trustline limit was cut to one stroop: the 100 NRV a full withdrawal returns cannot land.

hazards.placement: withdrawal into a trustline whose limit was cut below the pooled amount

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
